title: Face Parameter Slider Playground
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Robot Faces
description: Construct a complete, original facial expression by designing values for the eye size, eye spacing, eyebrow angle, and mouth curvature parameters, observing how draw_face() turns that one set of numbers into a complete rendered face.

learningObjectives: Construct a complete, original facial expression by designing values for the eye size, eye spacing, eyebrow angle, and mouth curvature parameters, observing how draw_face() turns that one set of numbers into a complete rendered face.
